create_SO3_from_quaternion: create an SO3 rotation group instance from a unit quaternion tensor
generate_random_SO3: generate random SO3 rotation matrices using the rand or randn static methods
convert_SO3_to_quaternion: convert an SO3 rotation matrix to a unit quaternion using to_quaternion
rotate_point_with_SO3: rotate a 3D point using an SO3 rotation and compute jacobians
compose_SO3_rotations: compose two SO3 rotations together using the compose method
